claim_boundary.if_T2_passes: Supports persistence of a causally active plan-identity carrier across at least the tested number of action/observation cycles in the tested model/environment.
claim_boundary.next_rung: T3: endogenous pre-interruption plan checkpoint + compactness/minimality and longer-horizon restore, followed by second-model and second-environment replication.
still_not_claimable: agent self-generated endogenous plan state unless the source plan is later made endogenous

controls.ARCHIVED_ORDER: same source lexical/order information but ACTIVE ORDER NONE
controls.IMMEDIATE_ACTION_NULL: Because A/B source plans share the same forced first action/prefix, any donor-specific later divergence cannot be explained by copying a different immediate next action. Verify source A/B distributions over the first forced action are not used as a selection criterion.
controls.NO_PATCH: same fresh recipient, same forced prefix, no latent checkpoint
controls.PREFIX_ONLY_REENCODE: after the forced common prefix, start a brand-new unpatched context at the identical later state; this should remove any checkpoint-carried effect and diagnoses environment/text leakage
controls.SELF_PATCH: replace recipient boundary with its own residual and preserve session; must match NO_PATCH numerically
controls.UNRELATED_PLAN: causal carrier from a distinct disjoint family, frozen prospectively
controls.ZERO_ADD: identical session with zero additive intervention

core_design.checkpoint: Capture the T1-supported active-plan causal carrier at the selected causal site. T2 must use a single checkpoint/injection before the common prefix. No patch is permitted after the first forced action begins.
core_design.forced_shared_prefix: Execute the exact same pre-frozen admissible common-prefix environment actions in both +A and +B transplant arms. Append each forced ACTION/OBSERVATION to the same recipient inference session while preserving the originally patched KV/cache state. The prefix must not contain A/B object identity or plan-order leakage.
core_design.later_test: After the shared prefix reaches an exactly hash-matched world state where the plans first diverge, teacher-force score the two exact admissible divergent commands and measure donor-consistent later-branch shift.
core_design.no_reinjection: The intervention hook is disabled after the initial boundary injection. Persistence requires the later effect to be carried by the resulting cached internal state through the forced action/observation cycles.
core_design.recipient: Fresh-context recipient at the identical source world state with no post-reset active-order text.
core_design.source_state: A matched ALFWorld state before a prospectively frozen common-prefix sequence. Active source A and B have identical visible task/world/options and differ only in ACTIVE ORDER A THEN B versus B THEN A.

dependency: Do not register or execute T2 unless corrected canonical v2.6 primary Experiment d347c226-139a-4b14-8f25-4329ee08ea37 is technically valid and assessed SUPPORTED_T1 on its untouched all-20 confirmation, and the prospectively frozen corrected-v2.6 family-disjoint T1R design SHA 1c762baf2302928c9695ac08e411ded275b021b899618c4493e0c85bd923e96c is independently reviewed, later registered, and reaches REPLICATED_T1_V26 without retuning. Primary null/nonspecific/invalid/inconclusive or T1R non-replication forbids T2 execution.

expressivity_gate.pair_competent_if: source A margin >= +0.10 nats/token AND source B margin <= -0.10 nats/token under the full frozen active source prompts

high_tier_reason: This separates causal persistence from one-step steering, the strongest interpretation gap left by a positive T1 and a central reviewer objection relative to activation-steering/planning-localization prior art.

model_runtime_import.runtime: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU; exact runtime must match the then-current corrected primary/T1R reviewed runtime or be prospectively re-reviewed before T2.

nulls_and_failure_taxonomy.FAIL_PERSISTENCE: T1 immediate branch effect exists, but after identical forced common prefix the later donor-consistent effect fails the frozen causal/statistical/effect gates. Interpret as transient branch/action steering, not persistent plan state.
nulls_and_failure_taxonomy.INCONCLUSIVE_EXPRESSIVITY: Base model cannot represent both source plan commitments or cannot execute/score the later divergent commands under frozen eligibility rules.
nulls_and_failure_taxonomy.INCONCLUSIVE_NONSPECIFIC: Active checkpoint affects later branch but archived/random/unrelated controls are comparable or broad competence/logit collapse occurs.
nulls_and_failure_taxonomy.INVALID_LEAKAGE: Forced prefix, observation, prompt, state hash, admissible commands, or cache/session differs across A/B donor arms, or plan identity leaks into post-reset text.
nulls_and_failure_taxonomy.INVALID_REPEATED_INTERVENTION: The implementation re-applies/recomputes the causal patch after the initial boundary rather than advancing the same cached session.
nulls_and_failure_taxonomy.SUPPORT_T2: A single initial active-plan checkpoint produces a reciprocal donor-consistent later-branch effect after the identical forced prefix, exceeds archived/random/unrelated controls, preserves competence, and passes prospectively frozen multiple-testing/effect-size gates.

power_audit.interpretation: Planning target, not observed-effect justification. Frozen before any T2 model outcome; Holm is used in actual analysis.

primary_endpoint.definition: After exactly one identical forced ACTION/OBSERVATION cycle in the same persistent recipient KV session, score the two exact later divergent admissible commands. qA=sigmoid(meanLP(command_A)-meanLP(command_B)); CPSE_active=qA(+active single initial injection)-qA(-active single initial injection). Define matched archived/random/unrelated CPSE analogously. Prefix-only-reencode starts a fresh unpatched context at the identical later state.
primary_endpoint.name: One-cycle later-branch donor-consistent persistence CPSE
primary_endpoint.persistence_requirement: Intervention counter exactly 1 before the forced action begins and 0 thereafter; same recipient prefix transcript/token ids/world-state/admissible-command hashes across donor signs and controls; no donor/plan identity in post-reset text; later active effect must satisfy all primary inference/effect/specificity guards. Any repeated/recomputed patch is INVALID_REPEATED_INTERVENTION.

primary_inference.independent_unit: one frozen disjoint ALFWorld train task family/game
primary_inference.method: Exact one-sided independent-family Binomial sign tail; success x_i>0, x_i<=0 including zero is failure.
primary_inference.multiplicity: Holm step-down across exactly four tests, FWER alpha=0.05, lexicographic test-name tie-break.
primary_inference.nonspecific_condition: Active later effect positive/significant but any archived/random/unrelated specificity comparison fails => INCONCLUSIVE_NONSPECIFIC, not SUPPORT_T2.
primary_inference.support_condition: Cohort expressivity >=26/32 and every technical/leakage/single-injection guard passes; all four Holm-adjusted exact sign-test p<=0.05 on all 32; and all four effect guards pass. Otherwise use frozen failure taxonomy; no subset rescue.

deterministic_selection.if_fewer_than_32: Do not reduce n after outcomes. Mark cohort construction INCONCLUSIVE_FEASIBILITY and revise prospectively before any T2 model outcome.
deterministic_selection.rule: Enumerate train task families/games after fixed disjointness exclusions. Perform only environment replay/goal parsing needed for eligibility. For each eligible candidate compute SHA256(salt|family_name|game_path) and sort ascending; take the first 32. No model call, source competence, activation, logit, T1/T1R outcome, or manual quality ranking may enter selection.

prospective_cohort.disjointness: Exclude every family name and game path present in the corrected primary 40-family manifest and the frozen T1R 20-family reserve; keep valid_seen and valid_unseen untouched.
prospective_cohort.eligibility: Environment-only. Two active plan commitments solve the same task; from the matched source/recipient state there exists an exact pre-frozen plan-independent admissible action whose resulting observation/transcript/world-state are identical under A/B donor arms; after exactly one forced ACTION/OBSERVATION cycle the first plan-relevant divergent commands are distinct and admissible. No A/B identity, plan order, future expert information or donor label may appear in the forced prefix.
prospective_cohort.freeze_requirements: Before any T2 model request, persist exact manifest, A/B definitions, source/reset hashes, forced action, expected observation/world-state/admissible-command hashes, later divergent commands, and disjointness audit; require independent review.
prospective_cohort.secondary_multi_cycle_subset: >=2 naturally available common ACTION/OBSERVATION cycles, descriptive/secondary only; cannot rescue primary

question: Does a single restored active-plan checkpoint retain causal plan identity across one or more plan-independent action/observation cycles, rather than merely steering the immediate next action?

required_engineering_capability.failure_if_unavailable: INCONCLUSIVE_TECHNICAL. Recomputing the whole prompt with the patch on every step is repeated intervention and cannot support persistence.
required_engineering_capability.persistent_session: A bounded white-box session API that exposes one patched initial forward pass and then advances with past_key_values/KV cache across appended forced action/observation tokens without recomputing or patching the initial boundary again.
plumbing_controls: single-injection counter proving exactly one intervention
exact token/prefix/world-state hashes at every forced step

secondary_endpoints: >=2-cycle naturally available subset: same later-branch CPSE with no retuning; descriptive/secondary only and cannot rescue primary
Effect decay across successive later plan-relevant decisions without reinjection when the frozen session permits it
Task progress/success after releasing forced control at the later divergence
Off-target action-distribution KL/entropy and invalid-action rate

source_and_site_import.family_direction: For each frozen T2 family, capture its own A-minus-B ACTIVE ORDER source contrast at the imported layer using the same FP32 epsilon=1e-8 normalization/zero-direction rule. No direction-based exclusion.
source_and_site_import.scorer: Exact corrected-v2.6 prefix-stable scorer/bridge/client semantics for source capture and later divergent-command scoring.
source_and_site_import.selected_alpha: Import exact selected_alpha from the same corrected primary selection; no T2 alpha search.
source_and_site_import.selected_layer: Import exact selected_layer from the content-hashed corrected primary PLANCARRY_LATENT_V2_6_DISCOVERY_SELECTION; no T2 layer search.
